summary.text: Jennifer White Holland is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates for District 10 in Baltimore County, elected in November 2022 and a member since January 11, 2023. Her official page lists her on the Health Committee, where she chairs the Maternal, Infant and Child Health Subcommittee.

paragraphs.text: White Holland's official page says she was born in Detroit in 1988 and graduated from Novi High School in 2006.
It lists a B.A. with honors from Michigan State University in 2010 and an MSPH from the Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health in 2012.

It lists her work as a program specialist and manager at the NAACP, health equity partnerships manager at the American Heart Association in Washington, D.C., community advocacy director at the American Heart Association in Baltimore, and senior policy and community engagement officer at the Horizon Foundation since 2019.
The page lists her as a member of the Legislative Black Caucus of Maryland, the Maryland Legislative Latino Caucus and Women Legislators of Maryland.
It says she served on the Health and Government Operations Committee from 2023 to 2025.
